summary: A system of sensors was developed and enhanced retrieving the information from the sensors and running it through an AI engine. Moreover, a dashboard was formed with an AI engine providing the farmers with advice on agricultural precautions considering sudden environmental changes and farm protection. In conclusion, the project addresses the challenge as it achieved what the challenge necessitates, assisting farmers to commence considering strengthening soil changes conditions. Furthermore, it has an importance due to assisting farmers to evade wasting money and time whether on useless soil strengthening strategies or adaptation to environmental changes
details:
The project utilizes the provided data from NASA transforming the theoretical information into a real applicable device that predicts the upcoming climate conditions assisting farmers to overcome any difficulties that hinder their development.

- Utilizing DHT22 which is a humidity temperature sensor detecting temperature in between -40:80 degree Celsius and Relative Humidity (RH) in between 0:100%

- Utilizing MQ sensor detecting a wide variety of harmful gases and air pollutants

- TDS, PH, and PMS sensors serving distinct monitoring and analytical functions, primarily split between water and air quality management.

- After taking readings from the sensors, it is a must to have a dashboard to manage the readings connected to an AI engine using C++ and python programming languages to build a full organized analytical dashboard.

- After confirming the readings from the sensors, they are delivered to the AI engine to ubiquitously compared to the database and analyze all the possible conditions.

All in all, the project indicates the changes in soil, temperature, pH, and all conditions mattering with plants, to analyse, justify, reasoning, and resulting with accurate advice to farmers to be informed by the risk index after comparing the data acquired by time with the provided database.
